name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your top foot resting on a bench, bottom leg under it.
Plant your forearm on the floor and lift your hips into a side plank.
Hold a straight line from head to heels, squeezing the top inner thigh down into the bench.
Hold for time, then switch sides. An elite adductor and lateral-core strengthener.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An advanced just your bodyweight core exercise for the adductors. Copenhagen Plank builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
